diagnostic_evidence.quote: Apply matrix Chernoff inequality (\cref{thm:chernoff}) conditionally, and then removing the conditioning, (as in Step 1 of the proof)

issues.failure_explanation: The uniform bound lambda_max(S_k) <= Delta needed by Theorem thm:chernoff holds only on the event E = {max_k ||W^T Omega(:,k)||^2 <= Delta}. The proof applies Chernoff conditionally on E but keeps the unconditional parameters mu_min = ell (Step 1) and mu_max = ell ||Z||_2^2 (Step 2). Conditioning on E changes the distribution of each column, so E[S_k | E_k] = E[S_k 1_{E_k}]/P(E_k) differs from E[S_k]; in particular lambda_min(E[Y|E]) is not shown to equal (or be at least) ell, and lambda_max(E[Y|E]) may exceed ell||Z||_2^2. The Chernoff exponents ell/Delta and mu_max/Delta and the thresholds (1-eps)ell, (1+eps)mu_max are therefore not justified as written. The same conditional argument is invoked verbatim in the proof of thm:subspaceembed ('As in Step 1 of the proof of \cref{thm:tantheta}').
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace conditioning by truncation: set S~_k = S_k 1_{E_k}, which are independent, satisfy 0 <= S~_k <= Delta I and sum S~_k <= Y; bound ||E[S_k 1_{E_k^c}]|| via the tail integral of Lemma lem:kronrank1 (of order Delta*delta/ell, small under the assumed lower bound on ell) so that mu_min >= ell(1-eta) and mu_max <= ell||Z||_2^2 (upper direction needs the analogous adjustment), then rerun Chernoff unconditionally and adjust constants.
issues.overall_effect: The high-probability bounds on ||(W^T Omega)^dagger||_2 and ||Z^T Omega||_2, hence all downstream error bounds for the range finder, the single-view algorithm, RHOSVD-KRP, RSTHOSVD-KRP and the subspace embedding, are not established with the stated constants.
issues.title: Matrix Chernoff applied conditionally on E with unconditional means mu_min, mu_max
issues.why_classification: A contained but nontrivial truncation/tail-integral argument with recomputed constants is required; the qualitative conclusions and rates survive.

issues.failure_explanation: Setting (N-r) exp(-eps^2 mu_max/((2+eps)Delta)) = delta/4 gives eps^2 = Gamma (2+eps) with Gamma = Delta ln(4(N-r)/delta)/mu_max, whose positive root is eps = Gamma/2 + sqrt(Gamma^2/4 + 2Gamma). This equals 2Gamma only when Gamma = 1; for Gamma < 1 (the regime of interest as ell grows) the root exceeds 2Gamma, so with eps = 2Gamma one has eps^2/(2+eps) = 2Gamma^2/(1+Gamma) < Gamma and the failure probability is not bounded by delta/4. Hence (1+2Gamma) in eqn:interupper2 and in the statement is unsupported; the argument only yields the factor 1 + Gamma/2 + sqrt(Gamma^2/4+2Gamma) (<= 1 + Gamma + sqrt(2Gamma)).

failure_location.quote: Set the upper bound equal to $\delta/4$, solve the quadratic equation for $\varepsilon$,  and choose the positive root to get $\varepsilon = 2 \Gamma$, where $\Gamma$ is defined in the statement of the theorem.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace 2Gamma by Gamma + sqrt(2Gamma) (or by 2 max{Gamma, sqrt(2Gamma)}) in thm:tantheta and propagate through thm:rrf, thm:added-1, thm:rhsovd_krp and thm:added-2.
issues.overall_effect: The factor (1+2Gamma) (and hence (1+2r(1+2Gamma)) in thm:rrf, and the corresponding factors in thm:added-1, thm:rhsovd_krp, thm:added-2) is not proven for Gamma < 1; the true factor decays like 1 + O(sqrt(Gamma)) rather than 1 + O(Gamma).
issues.title: Positive root of the Chernoff quadratic is not 2*Gamma when Gamma < 1
issues.why_classification: The fix is a constant recomputation but it necessarily weakens the advertised dependence on Gamma across all main theorems; comparable results survive with no new architecture.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: The assumptions on $\ell_r$ ensure that, by \cref{thm:rrf}, $\prob\{\mc{E}^c\}\le \delta/2$.

issues.failure_explanation: Invoking thm:rrf (resp. the proof of thm:tantheta) with failure probability delta/2 requires ell_r >= 8(r + r C_{K,d} ln^d(16 ell_r/delta)) ln(8r/delta) and ell_l >= 8(ell_r + ell_r C_{K,d} ln^d(16 ell_l/delta)) ln(8 ell_r/delta); the stated hypotheses omit the factor 8, so in the regime where the stated bound holds but the factor-8 bound fails the conclusion is unproven. In addition, the conclusion's constants are inconsistent with the proof: the proof yields (1+2r(1+2Gamma_r))(1+2 ell_r(1+2Gamma_l))||Sigma_perp||_F^2, whereas the statement has (1+Gamma_l) and the undefined quantity ||Sigma_F||_2^2, and the event E is defined with (1+2r(1+Gamma_r)) instead of thm:rrf's (1+2r(1+2Gamma_r)).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Insert the factor 8 in both sketch-size lower bounds and restate the conclusion as (1+2r(1+2Gamma_r))(1+2 ell_r(1+2Gamma_l))||Sigma_perp||_F^2 consistently with the proof (also fix 4(m^d-ell_l) to 8(m^d-ell_r) in the proof).
issues.overall_effect: As stated, thm:added-1 claims a guarantee under weaker sketch-size requirements than its proof supports and with constants that the proof does not produce.
issues.title: Single-view theorem hypotheses and constants do not match what the proof invokes/establishes
issues.why_classification: Local correction of hypotheses and constants to those already produced by the proof; the method, rate and scope are unchanged.
